policy.reference: identical-byte prebuilt ESM; Standard Schema validation, consumed output/checksum
policy.coldScope: process launch, module initialization, schema construction, one valid validation, JSON output and exit
policy.constructScope: schema construction plus one valid validation per iteration after module initialization; optimized modes include compile/JIT construction
policy.binaryScope: bun build --compile --minify, includes Bun runtime; no bytecode flag
policy.browserScope: bun build --target browser --minify; schema and Standard Schema validate exports; excludes benchmark harness
